## Summary

Describe the change in a few sentences.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Breaking change
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Test / tooling change

## Testing

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] Additional targeted verification completed if needed

## Documentation

- [ ] Documentation updated where relevant
- [ ] `npm run docs:api` reviewed if the public API changed
- [ ] `docs/pre-v1-notes.md` updated if the supported contract changed

## Checklist

- [ ] Changes are scoped and focused
- [ ] New behavior includes tests or a clear rationale for no tests
- [ ] I reviewed the diff for accidental API or config changes
- [ ] I reviewed release-impacting changes before requesting merge
